summary: TrendAI Vision One Container Security: container protection from build to runtime, with image scanning, Kubernetes checks and runtime protection.
value: Vulnerable and malicious images do not reach production.
Malicious processes and unexpected changes in a container are stopped.
simple: Container protection from build to termination: scans images for vulnerabilities, malware and secrets, checks Kubernetes configuration, keeps unsafe images out of the cluster, monitors containers at runtime and blocks suspicious activity; custom detection rules cost extra. Kubernetes, Amazon ECS and serverless containers. Part of the TrendAI Vision One platform (Trend Micro’s business unit, formerly Trend Vision One); licensed with TrendAI Flex credits that can be reallocated across platform solutions.
